correctness.rationale: Explicit all-n proof from bridge exchangeability, independent segments under arbitrary zero pins, a polynomial Palm derivative, Lagrange inversion for signed primitive excursions, and elementary derivative/convolution inequalities. Finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Peak count is a canonical local oscillation statistic; interior zero-return count is discrete bridge local time. The theorem gives a natural complete conditional first-moment law for every possible return count, strict convex response, and an unexpected location-independent all-subset zero-pinning identity; it also identifies exact positive covariance and its square-root order. These are structural relationships between distinct path statistics and not a mere normalization or small-sample table.
